data.one_liner: Customizable Flutter widget for single and multi-select dropdowns with search.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable Flutter widget supporting both single and multi-select dropdown dialogs. Includes features like searchable list items, keyboard navigation, focus control, and extensive styling options.
use_when: You need a dropdown component that supports both single and multi-select modes.
You want built-in search functionality within the dropdown list items.
You need keyboard and touch navigation support for accessibility.
avoid_when: You require native platform dropdown pickers without custom dialog overlays.
You only need standard simple Material dropdown menus without multi-selection.
strengths: Supports both single and multi-select modes
Searchable list items and keyboard navigation support
weaknesses: Limited to dialog-based dropdown layouts as described in features
Relatively new package with frequent initial releases
